about: One delta frame as commuterlviv.live.wire.encode writes it, and what the vehicles behind it were. tests/wire_test.py encodes `vehicles` and expects `bytes`; web/src/lib/wire.test.ts and mobile/test/wire_test.dart decode `bytes` and expect `vehicles` back, positions to `decoded`. Three vehicles - centre, south-west corner, far corner - and two gone ids
